Typedef Documentation

typedef uint32_t HxPropertyIndex_t

Property set Index.

Each property domain can have a set of instances. This index defines the index of each instance in the set.

For example, the usb domain could contain multiple devices. The Index would enumerate the usb devices. Property set index

HxResult HxPropertyGetNthID ( int  index,
HxPropertyId_t *  idp 
)

Get the nth property in the system (for iterating).

Given an integer up to the number of core properties in the system, set *idp to the corresponding property ID.

Parameters:
index IN: index
idp OUT: property id corresponding to index
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful, HX_NOT_FOUND if index is too large.

HxResult HxPropertyGetString ( HxPropertyId_t  id,
HxPropertyIndex_t  index,
char *  value,
size_t *  len 
)

Get a property's string value.

This function will set the string value of a property instance.

Parameters:
id IN: Property ID
index IN: Property set index
value OUT: Pointer to buffer to receive the string If NULL, only len is modified
len IN/OUT: When called the value pointed to by len is the size of the buffer value points to. Upon return the value pointed to is set to the amount of the value buffer that was used

HxResult HxPropertyRegisterCallback ( HxPropertyId_t  id,
HxMessageCallback  callback,
void *  data 
)

Register Callback for Property Change.

Register a callback for specific property changes. There is no need to set up a listener and so on, this API will handle that.

You could register multiple callbacks for the same property change message.

Parameters:
id IN: property id
callback IN: Message callback that triggers when the property changes.
data IN: Data context that is returned with the callback.
Returns:
HxResult: REturns HX_OK if successful.
